_comment: PNW ADU — Hayden's dad's new ADU company, Enumclaw/Buckley plateau. NOTHING about the business itself is verified yet (Recon/pnw-adu.md §6): every null below is a real unknown, never guessed on the page. The QA fact checks skip null phone/address/hours by design. BUILD IS PITCH/PUBLISH-BLOCKED (photo-blocked + publish_gate below). Hero (9/14 evening, Hayden): the ADD-ON FARMHOUSE concept render as a matched day/dusk pair — REV 2 (9/15 evening, Hayden): ONE slow one-way sweep on load — day → a golden sunset midpoint → dusk, ~8 s — then still; the drag/hover toy is GONE; depth parallax stays — labelled 'concept'. No sign board; the name lives in the header only. Bubbles show stills only (no push-in clips). CTA everywhere: 'Set up a consultation'. The dusk map shows a 15-mile ring from Buckley that nearly fills the frame (rev 2); the process section is one 'We handle it start to finish' band; the site mark is brand/logos/02-shared-wall.

asks_for_dad: 1. The name as he says it — PNW ADU / PNW ADU LLC? Registered business name + UBI; buy pnw-adu.com (unregistered 9/14) and say which registrar so DNS can point at GitHub Pages.

2. Photos — finished ADU whole from the yard at blue hour (two tripod frames: lights off / lights on), same unit in daylight, two whole-room interiors, the truck on a lot with the door readable, dad on site at work, any framing sequence, the mill/lumber stack if real, any existing lettering (original file). Until then the hero and the bubble frames are Higgsfield concept renders, every one tagged 'concept'.

3. Offer line — design-build turnkey? permits handled in-house? site work / septic / utilities? stick-built only or prefab set too? attached + garage conversions, or detached only? (decides the sub line and the five bubble lines — the fifth bubble is 'Inside the house' (basement/attic apartment, a KCC-recognised ADU type); the first build's 'Studio or shop' line was dropped 9/14 as an offer nobody gave. Until he answers, the page promises no permitting and no new-garage construction.)
4. WA contractor license number as printed + bonded/insured line — fills the hidden stake in #trust and the L&I link.

5. Service towns — confirm or edit the 13 'we build here' towns on the dusk map (Hayden's 9/14 list: Buckley hub + Enumclaw, Bonney Lake, Lake Tapps, Sumner, Puyallup, Orting, Black Diamond, Maple Valley, Auburn, Wilkeson, Carbonado, South Prairie) and the 15-mile ring (rev 2); how far will he really drive?
6. First project story — whose ADU (with permission), why, what, which county/city permitted it, start-to-keys time.
7. Years in construction + what Jared has built — fills the hidden 'years building' stake; numbers must be true.
8. Price posture — show ranges? 'From $___'? or 'walk the lot first'? Is the lot walk free? Numbers incl. tax? (no prices are on the site until he answers)

9. Contact + lead path — business phone (a cell that takes texts?), email, where form submissions go, hours he'll answer; Google Business Profile exists? (the Call button is `hidden` until a number exists — un-hide with a tel: href)

10. Rules confirmation — has he pulled a permit under the new Pierce code? which planner at Pierce PPW / King DLS / Enumclaw / Buckley? did Buckley adopt the 2025 draft? (the two 'country' tiles ship flagged unverified)
11. Tone — three sentences of how he'd describe the work to a neighbour, recorded not written, so the copy can be re-cut in his voice.

hero_assets.pair_match: ORB/RANSAC similarity day→dusk: wide scale 0.9996 rot -0.004° shift (-0.1, 0.2) px, 843/1481 inliers; tall scale 1.0000 rot -0.004° shift (-0.1, -0.5) px, 781/1420 inliers; dusk→day Canny edge recall .943 / .947 (the missing day edges are foliage/ground detail that goes dark at dusk, not drift) — same composition, the gadget is ON for both
hero_assets.event: REV 2 sweep (js/hero.js SWEEP): .6 s hold on the day, then --dusk 0→1 over 7.4 s power2.inOut (total 8.0 s); --gold 0→.55 over 2.8 s (sine.inOut) from .6 s, holds 1.2 s (peak 3.4–4.6 s ≈ 42–58 %), falls to 0 over 3.0 s (gone at 7.6 s). Once; then still. No toy, no pointer code. Reduced-motion / no-JS: dusk still, no sweep.
hero_assets.encode: stills q84 progressive at native px (PIL, 4:2:0 like the rest of images/hero/); depth layers WebP q82 at native px

map_assets.alignment_verified: 2026-09-14: dusk render vs NAIP at the nominal 0.72 x / 0.725 y scale — water-mask template match on Lake Tapps (+0,+1 px), Alder Lake (-2,+2), American Lake (-5,+1), Commencement Bay (-5,-1), Lake Youngs (0,0), Puget Sound/Vashon (-1,+2); max 5 px = 0.22% of the frame; whole-frame ORB/RANSAC fit scale 1.0048, rot -0.11 deg, shift (-4,-5) px, 332 inliers. No fit applied — nominal scale used.
map_assets.projection: x = (lon - W)/(E - W) * 2304; y = (merc(N) - merc(lat))/(merc(N) - merc(S)) * 1856; 28.373 px per mile at Buckley; ring15 r = 425.6 px (the 30-mile ring, r = 851.2 px, is gone — rev 2); Buckley at (50.00%, 50.22%)
map_assets.crop: rev 2: the plane is sized so the 15-mile ring nearly fills the frame with 12 px of air — plane width = (frame's shorter side − 24 px) / .36944 (ring diameter / image width); phones square, ≥760 13:10 (ring fills the height)
